steps.input:
mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-235afbe3.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != bg:
                continue
            left = next((grid[r][x] for x in range(c-1, -1, -1) if grid[r][x] != bg), None)
            right = next((grid[r][x] for x in range(c+1, w) if grid[r][x] != bg), None)
            up = next((grid[y][c] for y in range(r-1, -1, -1) if grid[y][c] != bg), None)
            down = next((grid[y][c] for y in range(r+1, h) if grid[y][c] != bg), None)
            if left is not None and right == left and up is not None and down == up and left == up:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
PY
